title: ResearchExportManifest
description: Manifest of one research export batch from the application to Workstream B (ADR-010). The batch is a JSONL file of feature records (contracts/voice-features/feature-record.schema.json v2.0.0) whose IDs have been re-keyed with an application-held HMAC key, timestamps truncated to the date and free text removed. Workstream B must verify the file hash, validate every record, apply withdrawn_record_ids before using any data, and never use model_training_excluded records for training. Contains no direct identifiers and no application IDs.

rekey.description: How IDs were re-keyed. The key itself never leaves the application.

key_id.description: Fingerprint identifying the key (not the key).

split_groups.description: Re-keyed session_id -> split group. Sessions of the same participant share a group, so Workstream B can make participant-level splits (model-validation-plan.md section 4) without receiving any participant reference.

model_training_excluded.description: Re-keyed record_ids in this file whose participant did not grant MODEL_TRAINING (or withdrew it). They may be used for research analysis but never for training.

withdrawn_record_ids.description: Re-keyed record_ids exported earlier whose consent has since been withdrawn. Workstream B must remove them before the next dataset build (consent-and-data-lifecycle.md section 4).

exclusions.description: Counts only (never IDs) of records not exported, by reason.

x-governance.note: Built only on explicit human request (CLAUDE.md rule 5). The HMAC key stays in the application environment.
